title: FAQ

seo.description: Answers to common questions about CHUWU fragrances, Bazi readings, ordering and payment.

intro: Can’t find what you’re looking for? Message us on WhatsApp.

items.question: What is a Bazi reading?
items.answer: Bazi (八字, "eight characters") describes the moment you were born as four pillars — year, month, day and hour — each made of two characters linked to the Five Elements. Counting those elements shows which ones your chart has plenty of and which it lacks.

items.question: Do I need to know my exact time of birth?
items.answer: No. Pick the two-hour block you were born in. If you don’t know it, leave the midday estimate — your year, month and day pillars stay accurate; only the hour pillar becomes approximate.

items.question: How do you choose a scent for me?
items.answer: After your Bazi reading, we show you which of the Five Elements your chart is lacking and recommend the CHUWU scents made for that element. If you told us which scent families you like, your favourites are shown first. Pick the one that speaks to you — or browse all our scents in the Shop.

items.question: How do I pay?
items.answer: By PayNow. After you place your order you’ll see a QR code with the amount and your order number already filled in — scan it with your banking app and confirm. No need to send us a screenshot.

items.question: How long until my order arrives?
items.answer: Once your payment is confirmed we’ll let you know on WhatsApp when your order is on its way. Personalised blends are made to order, so they take a little longer than signature blends.

items.question: Is this a professional Bazi consultation?
items.answer: No — the reading is a lifestyle and inspirational guide drawing on traditional Five Element theory, not a substitute for a professional consultation.
